text: [excited] It flew eight years to reach Mercury... [nervous] then its brakes cut out early!
[curious] Out there, the Sun keeps pulling you faster, so you brake the whole way.
Nine flybys. More energy than flying to Pluto.
[nervous] Saturday: the final braking burn. Then... the engines stopped. Too soon.
[relieved] Luckily, Mercury still caught it. Only the second spacecraft ever to orbit there.
[deadpan] Unluckily, it may be parked higher than planned.
[playfully] Would you trust that software? Send this to a friend who always brakes too late.
